purpose: Functional requirements for source ports from ASE ArkApi to native Linux plugins

upstream.license_scope: The root license does not establish licenses for arbitrary third-party plugins or dependencies

baseline.preferred_plugin_boundary: Versioned C POD and copied UTF-8 data
baseline.command_matching: Legacy exact complete message; opt-in verb and ASCII-case source extension awaiting validation
baseline.reply_lifetime: Current command invocation, owner and thread only
baseline.player_data: Copied observations; no authentication, storefront assertion or durable session handle
baseline.timer_execution: Worker thread; must not perform UE gameplay calls
baseline.operator_control: Private local OS-authorized plane, separate from player commands
baseline.cooperative_unload: Managed executable deliveries only; close admission, drain and clean before Shutdown and library close

priorities.P1: Useful read-only commands and managed gameplay scheduling
priorities.P3: Native game mutation with separate proofs

requirements: Recompile portable plugin source and dependencies as native Linux code
Adapt entry points and metadata to the runtime contract
Keep generated UE types and Windows field/native-call wrappers outside the plugin boundary
Specify encoding, ownership, limits and capability-dependent availability
acceptance: Short or missing API slots reject safely
Unsupported required operations reject Init
No Windows DLL loading claim

requirements: Every executable delivery belongs to its load generation
Unload failures preserve the mapped library
No detached executable work under the managed-only declaration
acceptance: Callbacks finish before data and code are released
Stale generations cannot revive after address reuse
Pause preserves registrations; reload uses explicit persisted state

requirements: Copy borrowed Init paths before retaining them
Map plugin-specific JSON schemas and instance ownership
Use reviewed configuration migration instead of overwriting old state
acceptance: Malformed config fails safely
Separate instances keep distinct mutable state
Config reload failure preserves the previous valid state

requirements: Define argument tokenization, case policy, aliases and collisions
Define command consumption and ordinary-chat behavior
Retain scoped targeted reply and UTF-8 limits
acceptance: Prefix collisions never execute the wrong command
Arguments and malformed text follow the declared policy
Two players receive only their own replies

requirements: Typed invalidatable destinations before deferred or broadcast sends
Separate server messages, sender-labelled chat and notifications
acceptance: Disconnected destinations reject delivery
Reconnect does not revive an old destination
The selected channel is visible in a real client

requirements: Copy observed sender and command context where verified
Treat suppression or rewrite as a separate policy contract with ordering
acceptance: Normal chat remains functional
Unknown sender fields stay unavailable
Observer success is not reported as moderation success

requirements: Provide managed main-thread delivery for game work
Define repeat counts, cadence, overrun, pause and cancellation rules
Keep external I/O separate from UE execution
acceptance: Game actions execute on the verified game thread
Pause does not lose a due one-shot or replay an accidental burst
No callback enters retired code

requirements: Copy views when retention is needed
Never reuse invocation tokens as player identity
Do not infer Steam or Epic from numeric shape
acceptance: Wrong owner, thread and stale invocation reject reads
Nested callbacks cannot read an outer invocation
Missing optional fields remain unavailable

requirements: Copied online roster and explicit identifier namespaces
Session invalidation on logout, reconnect and world replacement
Separate readiness, observation and authenticated principal contracts
acceptance: Steam and Epic tested independently
Interrupted login never creates an invented authenticated principal
Restart never revives process-local handles

requirements: Transport-authenticated copied command requests and results
Explicit principal and role provenance
Keep OS operator authority separate from player and plugin tokens
acceptance: Unauthorized commands fail closed
Same display name grants no authority
Remote RCON is not confused with the local operator socket

requirements: Specify native event pre/post phase and original-call behavior
Validate each supported build privately
Add copied event or action contracts for selected plugin needs
acceptance: Unsupported build disables the operation
Native calls outside ProcessEvent are not silently treated as observed
No observational field is used as return-override authority

requirements: Versioned storage and explicit identity migration
Transactions and retry/idempotency semantics
Owned I/O cancellation and managed completion before unload
acceptance: Partial migration can recover without losing existing data
Reload cannot deliver an old HTTP completion into new code
No process-local token is persisted as an account key

requirements: Implement only selected verified native game operations
Authoritative identifiers and invalidatable resources
Replay and duplication protection for grants, removal and currency changes
acceptance: Invalid or stale targets cause no mutation
Retry cannot duplicate a grant
Real clients verify each resulting game action

port_record_required: Availability decision for every required operation
